spans.s: स्तु vt. 2U (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after any preposition ending in इ or उ) (pp. स्तुत; pres. स्तौति, स्तवीति, स्तुते, स्तुवीते; pass. स्तूयते; desid. तुष्टूषति-ते) 1. To praise, to laud, to eulogize; 2. to glorify, to extol, to celebrate, Bt.viii.92; 3. to hymn, to praise or celebrate in song, to worship by hymns.With अभि-, to praise.With प्र-, 1. to praise; 2. to begin, तेन हि प्रस्तूयतां विवादः Mal.i.With सम्-, 1. to praise; 2. to be familiar with, अनेकशस्तंस्तुतमप्यनल्पा नवन्नवं प्रीतिरहो करोति Sis.iii.31, Kir.iii.2.
स्तुक m. A collection of hair, a knot.
स्तुका f. 1. A knot or braid of air; 2. a bunch of curly hair between the horns of a bull; 3. hip, thigh.
स्तुच् vt. 1Ā (pres. स्तोचते) 1. To be bright, to be pellucid; 2. to be propitious or pleased.
स्तुत a. (f. ता) 1. Praised, commended; 2. flattered.
स्तुत a. (f. ता) 1. Praised, commended; 2. flattered.
स्तुति f. 1. Praise, eulogy, commendation, hymn, स्तुत्यं स्तुतिभिरर्थ्याभिरुपतस्थे सरस्वती R.iv.6; 2. adulation, flattery, false praise, भूतार्थव्याहृतिः सा हि न स्तुतिः परमेष्ठिनः R.x.33.
स्तुति-पद n. an object of praise.
स्तुति-पाठक m. a panegyrist, an encomiast, a bard, a herald.
स्तुति-वाद m. a laudatory speech, panegyric.
स्तुति-व्रत m. a bard.
स्तुत्य a. (f. त्या) Laudable, praiseworthy.
स्तुत्य a. (f. त्या) Laudable, praiseworthy.
स्तुनक m. A goat.
स्तुभ् (I) vt. 1P (pres. स्तोभति) 1. To praise; 2. to celebrate, to worship.
स्तुभ् (II) vt. 1Ā (pres. स्तोभते) 1. To stop, to suppress; 2. to paralyze, to stupefy.
स्तुभ m. A goat.
स्तुंभ् vt. 5P, 9P (pres. स्तुभ्नोति, स्तुभ्नाति) 1. To stop; 2. to stupefy; 3. to expel.
स्तूप् vt. 4P, 10U (pres. स्तूप्यति, स्तूपयति-ते) 1. To heap up, to pile, to collect; 2. to erect.
स्तूप m. 1. A heap, a pile; 2. a Buddhistic construction for keeping holy relics; 3. a funeral pile.
